notes.title: First update / Erstes Update
notes.content:
Due to the massive feedback in the community (thanks for that) we had a heated meeting for many hours and finally we decided to work on our first update :)

We will work on the following points:

- treasure room mechanics
- "Confused" debuff
- custom hero names
- enemy information during battle
- battle Log
- shop improvement
- some content
- some polishing

The update will be released on coming Friday.

###############

Aufgrund der vielen Rückmeldungen in der Community (vielen Dank dafür) haben wir uns in einem mehrstündigen und hitzigen Meeting zusammengesetzt und beschlossen, an einem Update zu arbeiten :)

Es wird an folgenden Punkten gearbeitet:

- Schatztruhen Mechanik
- "Verwirrt" Status Effekt
- eigene Heldennamen
- Gegnerinformationen während der Kämpfe
- Kampf Log
- Shop Verbesserungen
- ein paar zusätzliche Inhalte
- ein wenig Politur auftragen

Das Update wird am kommenden Freitag erscheinen.

notes.title: Pixel Heroes Release (February, 6th 2015)
notes.content:
[h1]Radical Retro-RPG available on Steam from today[/h1]

Are you ready for a nostalgic adventure? An adventure that'll throw you back into a time when games were young and innocent, just like you? When you were sitting in front of your tube with burning eyes and just couldn't stop playing? 

Then enter the world of Pixel Heroes and start your epic journey [b]today[/b] [i](12:00 pm PST)[/i].
